description: v10 packaging manifest profile for apiVersion 4 mods.

properties.name: string
properties.provides: optional string[] of registries/content roots this mod owns
properties.uses: optional string[] hints; runtime reference scan stays authoritative
properties.files.optional: optional string[] of non-fatal file paths
properties.settings: optional object with schemaVersion, schemaFile, defaultDomain
properties.exports: registry namespaces exported by this package
properties.releaseChannels: stable|beta|testers (UI exposes stable only until v1.0)
properties.entryScript: optional path to runtime init script; required for wasm3-v1 and hybrid-v1
properties.runtime.module: path to .wasm|.wat; required for wasm3-v1 and hybrid-v1
properties.runtime.entryLibrary: path to native .dll; required for native-cpp-v1 and hybrid-v1
properties.runtime.abiVersion: optional integer ABI version for native-cpp-v1/hybrid-v1; defaults to 1
properties.runtime.nativeMode: optional sdk|raw for native-cpp-v1/hybrid-v1; defaults to sdk
properties.runtime.reloadPolicy: optional disabled|manual|safe; native raw should stay disabled/manual
properties.runtime.buildIdPolicy: optional ignore|match; match enforces plugin buildId against current engine build
properties.runtime.threadModel: optional main_thread|background_readonly; current native runtime expects main_thread
properties.assetSourceDefinitions: optional path to assets/sources.json; required for capability assets.raw.v1
properties.meshDefinitions: optional path to render/meshes.json; required for capability render.meshes.v1
properties.prefabDefinitions: optional path to actors/prefabs.json; required for capability actors.prefabs.v1
properties.worldInstanceDefinitions: optional path to world/instances.json; required for capability world.instances.v1
properties.editorPlacementDefinitions: optional path to editor/placement.json; required for capability editor.placement.v1
properties.worldAuthoringDefinitions: optional path to world/authoring.json; required for capability world.authoring.v1
